about_the_game:
🏆 Battle Royale Manager

AI-powered battle royale where your strategy determines who survives.

In Battle Royale Manager, you don’t control the fighters—you build them. Train survivors, develop personalized strategies, place bold bets, and watch the chaos unfold in fully simulated AI-driven battle royale matches. You're not a fighter. You're the mastermind behind the fight.

🎯 Key Features

  • Train and Enhance
    Improve your survivors’ stats through training, or go further with surgeries and modifications to give them an edge.

  • Tactical Behavior System
    Customize how each survivor behaves during the match. Set aggression levels, target priorities, movement preferences, and more.

  • Betting System
    Place bets before matches begin. Predict the winner, earn rewards, and reinvest in your fighters’ growth.

  • AI-Driven Battle Simulation
    All matches play out autonomously, driven by a sophisticated AI system that reacts to terrain, stats, and tactics.

  • Leagues and Rankings
    Climb the ladder by sending your best survivors into the league. Compete for prestige and rewards.

🧠 Strategy + Simulation + Management = The Ultimate Battle Royale

You don’t need to pull the trigger—your decisions already have.
Every victory is built before the battle begins: in the training room, in the strategy plan, and in your mind.
